content.title: Micro-Expression Greeting | Turn, Notice, Smile, Settle
content.summary: Use a nearly locked portrait to stage five small expression beats: begin in profile, establish direct gaze, pause with lowered eyes, peak on a closed-eye smile, then settle into an open relaxed expression without changing location or enlarging the performance.

quick_start.input_format: Single portrait + Start sideways + Steady direct gaze + Pause with lowered eyes + 1 peak expression + Open expression stabilizes
quick_start.recommended_input: The elderly paper restorer held the restoration map sideways, turned his head and looked straight, paused with his eyes lowered, closed his eyes and smiled, then opened his eyes and returned to a relaxed expression; the same quiet archives room was maintained throughout the process.
required_anchors: Begin from a readable side orientation rather than immediate frontal address.
Reach and hold direct gaze before the emotional peak.
Use one countable peak expression without a large body gesture.
Recover to an open relaxed state and hold.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Use a nearly locked portrait to stage five small expression beats: begin in profile, establish direct gaze, pause with lowered eyes, peak on a closed-eye smile, then settle into an open relaxed expression without changing location or enlarging the performance.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Use one nearly locked portrait to make a greeting readable through five small state changes: begin in side orientation, establish direct gaze, lower the gaze into a brief self-contained pause, peak with one closed-eye smile, and recover to an open relaxed expression without changing setting or adding a large gesture.

invariants.rule: Begin from a readable side orientation rather than immediate frontal address.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting frontal removes the orientation change.

invariants.rule: Reach and hold direct gaze before the emotional peak.
invariants.ablation_failure: A passing glance gives no stable connection.

invariants.rule: Insert one brief downward-gaze pause with the body still anchored.
Use one countable peak expression without a large body gesture.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the change legible at portrait scale.
invariants.ablation_failure: A broad wave or jump overwhelms the facial proof.

invariants.rule: Recover to an open relaxed state and hold.
invariants.purpose: Closes the greeting without looping abruptly.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending at the closed-eye peak feels cut off.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source sailor-style shirt and denim skirt
